hits.title: Convexity in semi-algebraic geometry and polynomial optimization

hits.title: On the monotonization of the training set
hits.snippet: We consider the problem of minimal correction of the training set to make it consistent with monotonic constraints. hits.title: Lower bounds for the minimax risk using $f$-divergences and applications
hits.snippet: Lower bounds involving $f$-divergences between the underlying probability measures are proved for the minimax risk in estimation problems. Our proofs just use simple convexity facts. hits.title: An Algorithm for Unconstrained Quadratically Penalized Convex Optimization
hits.snippet: A descent algorithm, "Quasi-Quadratic Minimization with Memory" (QQMM), is proposed for unconstrained minimization of the sum, $F$, of a non-negative convex function, $V$, and a quadratic form.
